text:
adele: Heads-up: planning a tenant-scoped schema rollout tonight in the 22:15 UTC window. Job id `tenant-shadow-2026-03-21a`. Canary 6 tenants, then staggered waves. Dry-run showed elevated row-lock waits on one shard. Pinning runner to schema:v3.2.1 and enabling `tourniquet` throttle. Need quick ack and runbook link.

sam: share the dry-run excerpt and the abort steps pls.

adele: paste (trimmed):
[2026-03-21T18:12:05Z] backfill-0: start tenants 4200..4205
[2026-03-21T18:12:11Z] db: wait_for_lock tenants (18s)
[2026-03-21T18:12:29Z] db: lock acquired (ROW SHARE)
[2026-03-21T18:12:45Z] backfill-0: batch 3 ok
We didn't see ACCESS EXCLUSIVE, but 18s waits could affect heavy writers.

matt: Two mitigation paths: (1) implicit add + async backfill (low concurrency) or (2) copy-and-swap for noisy tenants. (1) is faster and tested.

db-ops: agree (1). I'll monitor lock_wait_95 and p95 write latency. Propose abort triggers: lock_wait > 30s, sustained write_error_rate >1% for 2m, or p95 write latency >500ms for 2m. If triggered, we soft-pause then abort.

adele: escape commands in runbook: `deploy-bot pause-job tenant-shadow-2026-03-21a --graceful`, `deploy-bot abort-job tenant-shadow-2026-03-21a --reason "lock_threshold"`, `deploy-bot rollback-job --id tenant-shadow-2026-03-21a --force`. Will pin `runner.version=schema:v3.2.1, max_concurrent_backfills=1, chunk_ms=300, tourniquet=true`.

deploy-bot: [automation] Migration scheduled: tenant-shadow-2026-03-21a  state: scheduled -> canary. Canary size: 6 tenants. Holdpoint at canary_end webhook.

sam: ack :thumbsup: I added runbook link https://redwood.internal/releases/tenant-shadow-2026-03-21a and noted rollback criteria.

matt: ack. Set alerts to page db-ops on threshold. Also log owner for each wave in the runbook.

adele: starting canary now. Will post canary_end metrics.

deploy-bot: [automation] Canary start: tenant-shadow-2026-03-21a  canary_size=6. Expected ~7m.

deploy-bot: [automation] Canary end: 6 tenants processed  max_lock_wait=20s, write_error_rate=0.4%, p95_write_latency=290ms. Canary PASSED. Proceeding to Wave 1 (ranges 4206-4599) with backfill_pause_between_waves=45s.

db-ops: watching metrics. If lock_wait >30s I'll abort and post reason.

sam: documented the final thresholds in release notes. Also added the per-tenant resume steps for resumable backfills.

adele: kicking off Wave 1. Will update every 10m or on abort.

db-ops: monitoring now. Good luck team.

(End of thread)
